anchors.label: SECDEBT
anchors.description: Corporate debt section marker embedded at the start of this filer's debt identifiers.
examples: US Corporate Debt | 1st Lien/Senior Secured Debt | CHV Holdings LLC | Digital Infrastructure & Services | Term Loan | 12.56% (S + 4.00%; 1.00% Floor; 4.75% PIK) | 3/27/2029

evidence.observation: Debt table rows carry issuer, industry, instrument type, rate terms, and maturity.

anchors.label: RATE
anchors.description: Embedded stated rate or rate placeholder followed by parenthesized floating-rate terms.

evidence.observation: Source row shows stated percentage followed by S + spread and floor terms.

anchors.label: MAT
anchors.description: Embedded slash-form maturity or investment date at the end of identifiers.

evidence.observation: Debt source row includes a slash-form maturity date.
Investment-company rows do not show the section marker in each position row but do use the same table section.

anchors.label: INVCO
anchors.description: Investment company / fund interest section marker used for LP interests and units.
examples: U.S. Investment Companies | AB Equity Investors, L.P. | LP Interests
U.S. Investment Companies | Falcon Co-Investment Partners, L.P. | Units

evidence.observation: Section row shows U.S. Investment Companies, followed by LP Interests and Units position rows.

notes: Proposal adds the minimum anchors needed for the active dominant debt signature and for investment-company rows currently landing in (none).
